## Purpose

Describe the user-visible problem and the chosen solution.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] `uv run pytest backend/tests` passes
- [ ] Documentation updated where behavior or configuration changed

## Security and data checklist

- [ ] No credentials, `.env`, private PDFs, databases, indexes, or private logs
- [ ] Authentication/authorization impact reviewed
- [ ] File paths, uploads, MCP commands, and outbound requests reviewed if touched
- [ ] New dependencies have compatible licenses and updated notices
